audit.why: HARD 8.5/10 matches the mirror, which explicitly left diff, diffRating and carryRating alone. Olaf owns every lane row; Poppy only takes over once fights stop being duels.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill, Olaf, Olaf, Skill, Skill, Olaf, Olaf in both layers; the packet has Olaf through row 5 and the mirror shipped Olaf x6 then Poppy.
audit.why: whys[0], whys[3] and whys[4] all describe Olaf winning those rows while the printed side said Skill, and whys[6] describes Poppy's gold-independent utility on a row given to Olaf.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 4 and 6 flipped as one atomic paired group in both layers: Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Poppy, ratings moved to 3/5/5/3/3/5/6. Row 6 is Poppy rather than the packet's Skill, matching the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two ability errors. Ragnarok is described as 'CC-immune and true-damage' — the true damage is Reckless Swing (E, 325 range, 11-7s, costs Olaf health); Ragnarok grants resists passively and disable immunity while he keeps attacking. And several fields sell Steadfast Presence's dash-stop against an Olaf who has no dash at all.
audit.why: A player told his ult deals true damage will build the wrong resistances, and a player holding a 20s W as a parry against a non-existent dash loses the trade twice.
audit.corrected: True damage attributed to Reckless Swing; Ragnarok restated as disable immunity on 100/90/80s; W's value here restated as its passive resists; Tough It Out's shield named as the thing to force out before committing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Undertow's cooldown reset on axe pickup is never stated, though the page repeatedly refers to 'axe pickup'.
audit.why: It is the whole punish window: a thrown axe he cannot retrieve leaves him on a flat 9s cooldown with no slow.
audit.corrected: Added to the early block — deny the pickup and you get a real 9s window.

edits.before: Olaf out-trades you at every early level because his axe slow plus lifesteal beats your flat base damage in a straight brawl — your Q only chunks his max HP, it doesn't kill. Don't walk up for a Q he can answer by landing an axe and chasing you down. Your one real tool is E into a wall for the stun, but a missed Heroic Charge just shoves him forward into axe range, so only commit it with a genuine wall behind him and Q ready to follow.

Undertow resets the moment he picks the axe back up — walk him away from it and he waits the full 9s with no slow. edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay his — your damage doesn't scale with points and he's stacking sustain. At 6 it gets worse, not better: his Ragnarok is the matchup-defining ability, going fully CC-immune, so your E wall-stun and W grounding simply don't register while it's up. Bait or wait out his R before any all-in; if he pops it on you, disengage with W's move-speed and Q-slow rather than trying to land a stun that won't land.

edits.before: Once you hit first item you finally hold even footing — cheap tank components let you tank his axes, your Q chunks him percent-HP, and your kit value is gold-independent. By 2+ items his lifesteal-plus-axe DPS flattens you in the 1v1, but this is where you stop dueling and start using your real edges: W denies his Flash/dash engage onto your team, R lifts him clean off a carry, and your percent-HP Q stays relevant no matter his items.
edits.after: Once you hit first item you finally hold even footing — cheap tank components let you tank his axes, your Q chunks his max HP, and your kit value is gold-independent.
